name: browser-use
headline: claude code mobile ssh: pwa app with ssh access
short_description: A PWA App, Graphical Client for Claude Code, via SSH, **with Powerful Integrations for Graphcal Operations**!! For Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and any PWA supporting OS.
author: aiya000

sections.overview:
Claude Code Mobile SSH is a progressive web app that provides a graphical interface for interacting with Claude Code remotely over SSH. Unlike general-purpose AI agent apps, it's purpose-built for Claude Code workflows, letting developers easily send prompts, respond to yes/no decisions, and view results without complex terminal navigation. It works across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux, solving the friction of using Claude Code on smartphones and remote environments. The app prioritizes developer experience by simplifying interactions that would normally require keyboard shortcuts or terminal tab switching in RDP/VNC solutions.
Using Claude Code on smartphones or tablets while away from desktop
Remote development workflows via SSH without RDP/VNC overhead
Simplified conversation and decision-making with Claude Code
Cross-platform mobile access to local or remote Claude Code instances
The PWA app will serve as a graphical client for Claude Code, enabling seamless SSH connections and powerful graphical operations. It will be compatible with multiple operating systems, including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and any PWA supporting OS.
